backend.description: The ID of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

domain_id.description:
Id of the domain to create.
Must be a valid domain name, such as "foo.com"
domain_id.rationale: Custom domain ID has no specific security policy.

location.description: The location of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.

serve.description:
The serving behavior of the domain. If specified, the domain will
serve content other than its Backend's live content.

serve.redirect.description: Specifies redirect behavior for a domain.

serve.redirect.status.description:
The status code to use in a redirect response. Must be a valid HTTP 3XX
status code. Defaults to 302 if not present.
serve.redirect.status.rationale: Redirect status code has no specific security policy.

serve.redirect.uri.description:
The URI of the redirect's intended destination. This URI will be
prepended to the original request path. URI without a scheme are
assumed to be HTTPS.
serve.redirect.uri.rationale: Redirect URI has no specific security policy.
